learningObjectives: Identify useful features from raw datasets.
Apply encoding and scaling techniques to numerical and categorical data.
Construct a preprocessing workflow for machine learning.

activities.title: Discover Useful Features
activities.instruction: Identify variables that could provide useful information for prediction.

content.concept: Feature engineering transforms raw variables into useful representations that can improve the information available to a machine learning model.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Can represent a customer's demographic characteristic.
Can provide information about spending capacity.
Usually serves as an identifier rather than a meaningful predictive feature.
Can describe how frequently a customer makes purchases.
Can be transformed into useful features such as account age or signup month.

activities.title: Encode Categories
activities.instruction: Match categorical data with an appropriate encoding approach.

content.concept: Categorical variables can be converted into numerical representations using techniques such as one-hot encoding and ordinal encoding.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: City: Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi → One-Hot Encoding
Size: Small, Medium, Large → Ordinal Encoding
Gender: Category values with no natural order → One-Hot Encoding
Education Level: School, Bachelor, Master, Doctorate → Ordinal Encoding
config.answer: City: Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi → One-Hot Encoding

activities.title: Explore Feature Scaling
activities.instruction: Adjust the feature range and observe how scaling changes its representation.

content.concept: Feature scaling transforms numerical variables to comparable ranges and can be important for algorithms that depend on distances or feature magnitudes.

activities.title: Build the Preprocessing Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the preprocessing stages in a logical order.

content.concept: A preprocessing workflow can handle missing values, encode categorical variables, scale numerical features, and prepare the final feature set before model training.
